tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: Pane background. Prefer the terminal's own background (Color::Reset) and paint this only when `theme.paint_background = true`. ANSI-256: 233 / 255 · 16-color: default bg.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Header bar, footer bar and popups (help, command palette). ANSI-256: 234 / 254 · 16-color: default bg.

tokens.name: bg-select
tokens.usage: Background of the row under the cursor in any list. Every text token passes 4.5:1 on it. ANSI-256: 236 / 253 · 16-color: reverse video (SGR 7).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Borders of unfocused panes (plain ┌─┐ set) and table rules. Decorative only — never the sole carrier of meaning. ANSI-256: 238 / 247 · 16-color: bright black (8).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: track titles, list items, lyrics current line in 16-color mode. 13.9:1 / 14.5:1 on bg-base. ANSI-256: 253 / 234 · 16-color: default fg.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: artist, album, durations, column headers, inactive lyrics lines, key hints. ≥4.9:1 on bg-select in both themes. ANSI-256: 247 / 240 · 16-color: SGR 2 (dim).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled items, placeholder text in the search box, scrollbar track. Below 4.5:1 by design — never for information a user must read. ANSI-256: 241 / 244 · 16-color: bright black (8).

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Identity accent. The now-playing marker ▶, progress fill, liked ♥, current lyrics line. ANSI-256: 209 / 130 · 16-color: bright red (9).

tokens.name: lagoon
tokens.usage: Focus. Border + title of the focused pane (rounded ╭─╮ set), the list cursor ›, active sidebar item, search caret. ANSI-256: 79 / 23 · 16-color: cyan (6).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Attention without failure: buffering, rate-limit backoff countdown, 'cached' badge, toast warnings. ANSI-256: 179 / 94 · 16-color: yellow (3).

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Healthy state: network indicator online, download complete, auth valid. Paired with a glyph (●) so it never relies on hue. ANSI-256: 114 / 22 · 16-color: green (2).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Failures: stream expired and unrecoverable, auth rejected, offline. Always with ✗ and text. Lighter than ember in dark, darker in light so the two separate by lightness. ANSI-256: 204 / 124 · 16-color: red (1) + bold.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Alias. Focused pane border and title.

tokens.name: progress-fill
tokens.usage: Alias. Elapsed part of the progress bar ━━━●; the remaining part uses border.

tokens.name: liked
tokens.usage: Alias. The ♥ glyph next to liked tracks.

tokens.name: net-online
tokens.usage: Alias. ● online indicator in the header.

tokens.name: spectrum-low
tokens.usage: Alias. Visualizer bars, bottom third of the height.

tokens.name: spectrum-mid
tokens.usage: Alias. Visualizer bars, middle third.

tokens.name: spectrum-high
tokens.usage: Alias. Visualizer bars, top third (peaks).

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", "Iosevka Term", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: cell
styles.usage: Everything in the TUI. One size: the terminal decides it; we only choose weight and color.

styles.name: cell-bold
styles.usage: SGR 1. Now-playing title, focused pane title, current lyrics line.

styles.name: cell-dim
styles.usage: SGR 2 equivalent; render with ink-muted in 256/TrueColor, real SGR 2 only in 16-color mode.

styles.name: cell-italic
styles.usage: SGR 3. Lyrics annotations and empty-state hints only; many terminal fonts lack italics, so never load-bearing.

styles.name: pane-title
styles.usage: Uppercase pane titles embedded in the top border (' SEARCH › lowtide ').

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Docs, README banner and this system's cover only — never inside the terminal.

styles.name: doc-body
styles.usage: Prose in docs and the --help man page renderer.

spacing.note: The TUI lays out in cells, not pixels. Pixel values are the 14px-font approximation used by previews; code uses the column/row counts in each usage note.

tokens.name: col-1
tokens.usage: 1 column. Inner horizontal padding of every pane; gap between table columns.

tokens.name: col-2
tokens.usage: 2 columns. Indent for nested items (sidebar playlists) and the gap before right-aligned footer metadata.

tokens.name: row-1
tokens.usage: 1 row. Height of every list item; one blank row separates sidebar groups.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: 20 columns fixed. Collapses to 3-column icon rail below 90 terminal columns.

tokens.name: side-panel-w
tokens.usage: 24 columns default (lyrics / spectrum). Hidden below 110 columns; toggled with V.

tokens.name: footer-h
tokens.usage: 3 rows fixed: track line, progress line, key-hint line (hint line hides below 24 rows).

tokens.name: radius-square
tokens.usage: Plain border set ┌─┐└─┘ — unfocused panes, tables.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Rounded border set ╭─╮╰─╯ (ratatui BorderType::Rounded) — the focused pane and every popup. Shape + lagoon color mark focus together.
